title: The Quiet Orbit
author: Zephyrine Crane
blurb: Cyrus Dunmore, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
